verses: Parh apney rab kay naam say jiss ney peda kiya
Jiss ney insan ko khoon kay lothray say peda kiya
To parhta reh tera rab baray karam wala hai
Jiss ney qalam kay zariye (ilm) sikhaya
Jiss ney insan ko woh sikhaya jissay woh nahi janta tha
Sach much insan to aa pay say bahir ho jata hai
Uss liye kay woh apney aap ko bey perwa (ya toongar) samjhta hai
Yaqeenan lotna teray rab ki taraf hai
(bhala) ussay bhi tu ney dekha jo banday ko rokta hai
Jabkay woh bandah namaz ada kerta hai
Bhala batla to agar woh hidayat per ho
Ya perhez gaari ka hukum deta ho
Bhala dekho to agar yeh jhutlata ho aur mun perhta ho to
Kiya uss ney nahi jana kay Allah Taalaa ussay khoob dekh raha hai
Yaqeenan agar yeh baaz na raha to hum uss ki peshani kay baal pakar ker ghaseetein gay
Aisi peshani jo jhooti khata kaar hai
Yeh apni majlis walon ko bula
Hum bhi (dozakh kay) kay)piyadon ko len gay
Khabardaar! uss ka kehna hergiz na manna aur sajdah ker aur qareeb ho jaa
